stem.en: Little ___ that the small shop she opened would one day employ over a hundred people.

why.en: A negative word like 'Little' at the start triggers inversion: Little did she imagine …
why.uz: Gap boshidagi «Little» kabi inkor maʼnoli soʻz inversiya talab qiladi: «Little did she imagine …».
why.ru: Отрицательное слово вроде «Little» в начале требует инверсии: «Little did she imagine …».

stem.en: ___ as it may seem, the simplest solution was also the most effective.

why.en: 'Adjective + as + it may seem' is a concessive pattern: Strange as it may seem = Although it may seem strange.
why.uz: «Sifat + as + it may seem» toʻsiqsiz qurilma: Strange as it may seem = Although it may seem strange.
why.ru: «Прилагательное + as + it may seem» — уступительная конструкция: Strange as it may seem = Although it may seem strange.

why.ru: «Only by + -ing» в начале вызывает инверсию в главной части: will we be able.

why.ru: «Such was + существительное + that» — эмфатическая инверсия: спрос был так велик, что …

stem.en:
To call the plan ambitious would be generous; most of the engineers privately considered it unworkable.
What is the writer suggesting?

options.en: The engineers praised the plan in public meetings.
The plan was cautious and modest in its aims.
The writer admires the ambition behind the plan.

why.en: 'Would be generous' means 'ambitious' is too kind a word; the engineers thought it unworkable.
why.uz: «Would be generous» — «ambitious» soʻzi juda yumshoq ekanini bildiradi; muhandislar rejani amalga oshmaydi deb hisoblagan.
why.ru: «Would be generous» значит, что слово «ambitious» слишком мягкое: инженеры считали план невыполнимым.

stem.en:
Her apology, delivered a full week after the incident and only once the story had reached the newspapers, persuaded few.
Why did few people accept the apology?

options.en: Its timing suggested concern for her image, not regret.
Its wording seemed vague and too carefully rehearsed.
It blamed other people for part of what happened.
It was offered before all the facts were known.

why.en: It came 'a full week' late and 'only once the story had reached the newspapers', so it looked like image control rather than regret; its wording and content are not described.
why.uz: Kechirim bir hafta kechikib va faqat voqea gazetalarga chiqqandan keyin aytilgan, shuning uchun u pushaymonlik emas, obroʻni saqlashga urinishdek koʻringan; uning soʻzlari haqida hech narsa aytilmagan.
why.ru: Извинение прозвучало через неделю и лишь после публикаций в газетах, поэтому казалось заботой об имидже, а не сожалением; о его словах ничего не сказано.

stem.en:
The director's latest film is, if anything, even bleaker than her previous one, which few critics would have thought possible.
What does the sentence imply about the previous film?

options.en: It was praised by every critic.
It was not directed by her.

why.en: 'Even bleaker' and 'few would have thought possible' imply the earlier film was already very bleak.
why.uz: «Even bleaker» va «few … would have thought possible» avvalgi film ham juda tushkun boʻlganini bildiradi.
why.ru: «Even bleaker» и «few … would have thought possible» означают, что и прежний фильм был очень мрачным.
